nodes.description: A patent document titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for assisting medical diagnosis by exploiting similarity between new medical cases and existing cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of the patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based approach for assisting diagnosis through similarity matching of medical cases and experts.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space containing existing medical cases and experts, allows selection between query-for-cases and query-for-experts, and returns subsets based on computed similarity.

A multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are represented as embeddings.<SEP>A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so that similarity between their representations can be computed.

A medical case submitted by a requester for which a diagnosis is sought, embedded in an embedding space.<SEP>A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space for similarity comparison.

A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space and used for similarity comparison.<SEP>A set of previously stored medical cases that are embedded in the embedding space and compared against a new medical case to return a similar subset.

A set of experts embedded in the embedding space who can be queried and to whom new cases may be communicated for diagnosis.<SEP>A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as their profile, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases, who may be selected to formulate a diagnosis.

A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.<SEP>A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from available query types.

A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded experts.<SEP>A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.
A structure comprising a set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used as the basis for embedding cases and experts.
A medical ontology on which the embedding of medical cases and experts is based.
A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.

A representation of a medical case or expert generated in the embedding space.<SEP>A computed representation of a medical case based on a medical ontology, used to embed the case in the embedding space.
A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost operations.
A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the diagnosis assistance method.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
A database from which documents are returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space when the query-for-cases is selected.

A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.
Information associated with an expert, such as profile details, used as a basis for embedding the expert in the embedding space.
A rating of an expert used, along with availability and number of followers, as a basis for returning the subset of experts.
The availability of an expert, used as a basis for returning the subset of experts when the query-for-experts is selected.
The number of followers of an expert among users of the system, used as a basis for returning the subset of experts.
A provision for making a payment to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when the query-for-experts is selected.
A plurality of selectable query types including a query-for-cases and a query-for-experts.
A processor in communication with memory that executes stored instructions.
Memory that stores instructions for performing the query and diagnosis assistance operations.
A system comprising memory and a processor that provides diagnosis assistance by handling queries for cases and experts.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices linking requesters and experts with the system.
A set of devices for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
The diagnosis sought for a new medical case, which an expert may attempt to provide.

edges.description: The patent US9589231B2 describes a method for diagnosis assistance exploiting similarity between a new medical case and existing medical cases and experts.
The diagnosis assistance method embeds a new medical case in an embedding space in which existing medical cases and experts are also embedded.
The diagnosis assistance method receives a query request including a new medical case and embeds it in the embedding space.
The diagnosis assistance method returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity with the embedded new case when query-for-cases is selected.
The diagnosis assistance method returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity with the embedded new case when query-for-experts is selected.
The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select the query-for-cases query type.
The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select the query-for-experts query type.
The diagnosis assistance method computes a cost for the query, with the query-for-experts cost differing from the query-for-cases cost.
The embedding of the new medical case, existing medical cases, and experts is based on a medical ontology.
At least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost is performed with a computer processor.
The system comprises memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor for executing the instructions.
The computer program product stores instructions that when executed cause a computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
The new medical case is embedded in an embedding space.
The set of existing medical cases is embedded in the embedding space.
The set of experts is embedded in the embedding space.
Multidimensional representations of cases and experts are generated in the embedding space.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records relating to a specific patient.
When the query-for-experts is selected, the new case is provided to a selected one of the subset of experts for formulating a diagnosis.
The requester submits a query request that includes a new medical case.
The new case is communicated to one of the subset of experts.
A multidimensional representation of the new case is generated in the embedding space.
When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the cases is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.
Experts are embedded based on information associated with the expert, including the expert profile.
The returning of the subset of experts is also based on a rating of the expert.
The returning of the subset of experts is also based on an availability of the expert.
The returning of the subset of experts is also based on a number of followers of the expert among users of the system.
When the query-for-experts is selected, a subset of the experts is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.
The user devices link experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
A new case is communicated to one of the subset of experts for the expert to attempt to provide a diagnosis.
The requester is provided for to select from a plurality of query types including the query-for-cases.
The requester is provided for to select from a plurality of query types including the query-for-experts.
The requester is provided the ability to select from a plurality of query types.
The user devices link requesters with the diagnosis assistance system.
The cost for a query-for-cases differs from the cost for a query-for-experts.<SEP>The computed query cost is lower for a query-for-cases than for a query-for-experts.
When the query-for-cases is selected, documents from a public database are returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded documents.
The plurality of query types includes a query-for-cases.
The cost for a query-for-experts is different from the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>The computed query cost is higher for a query-for-experts than for a query-for-cases.
When the query-for-experts is selected, provision is made for making a payment to the expert for formulating the diagnosis.
The plurality of query types includes a query-for-experts.
The medical ontology is based on the Unified Medical Language System.
The medical ontology comprises medical concepts joined by links, each corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation.
A matrix of proximities is applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case to account for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
The processor is in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises a processor in communication with the memory.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises memory which stores instructions.
The network comprises a system for diagnosis assistance.
The network comprises a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
